summary: I read all 14 room pages' relevant parts plus every link target, and Resonant Link Labels for the label register. Of the 14 weak links, 11 had a sentence on one or both pages carrying the relation and got a label; 3 are cuts (Adjacent Affordance to Stoicism and to SUBSTRATE, Registry Pattern to Lossy Compression). The pattern: nearly every labelled link was a body-level citation (a page naming the other in its own text or open questions) that had simply never been promoted to a label, so the labels are mostly lifted straight from the prose; the cuts are links where the connection was a shared word (substrate) or a tradition already carried by a better link. Two Four Virtues links (Confucianism and Fortress) share one open-question sentence, so I labelled both but the Confucianism one is the weaker and could reasonably be dropped instead. One newcomer inbound is proposed (Shopkeeper spawned CAD Drafter). I could not settle: whether the Registry Pattern and Lossy Compression pair has a real tie (I saw only a faint prior/constraint resemblance and refused to force it), and whether the dollar figures on LoRA Trainer and Frame Designer count as the no-money-talk rule's concern (offered as lighter prose, not asserted). Doubled pairs among the held links (GAD with Registry Pattern and Synthesis Topologies, Depth Anything with SAM) are flagged for a one-link-per-pair cleanup; I did not add beside any.
